principles: Anchored on the designer's own Figma timings: 50ms ease-out for hover micro-motion (56 reactions), 150ms ease-in-out for control toggles (10 reactions) — extended into a coherent scale for surfaces Figma can't express.
Transform + opacity only — everything runs at 60fps on the compositor; no layout-property animation.
Orchestrated, not decorated: one hero motion per interaction; everything else supports it.
prefers-reduced-motion collapses all motion to fast opacity fades (80ms) — no exceptions.

Implementation: the `motion` library (Framer Motion) for springs/orchestration + CSS transitions for micro-states; motion tokens defined once (durations 50/150/200/280/400ms; easings standard cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), decelerate cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1), spring stiffness 380 damping 30).
surfaces: Hover states (buttons, rows, nav items)
background/color transition 50ms ease-out — exactly the Figma value; no transform
Dropdowns & popovers (stage menu, filters, tasks, assign, customise)
scale 0.96→1 + fade, transform-origin at the anchor, 150ms decelerate in / 100ms fade out; 8px overshoot-free
Modals (create/edit, delete confirm, import wizard)
overlay fade 200ms; panel fade + scale 0.98→1 rise 8px, 200ms decelerate; exit 150ms reverse
Sheets (Deleted Leads, Import History, AI suggestions)
slide-up 24px + fade 240ms decelerate; overlay in parallel; exit slide-down 180ms
Move Stage wizard steps
cross-fade + 16px horizontal slide in step direction, 220ms standard; stepper rail states smart-animate style 150ms; error shake on failed Save: 3× 4px, 280ms
Kanban drag-and-drop (hero motion)
lift: scale 1.03 + shadow elevation + 2° tilt, spring; siblings part with 200ms standard; drop: spring settle (stiffness 380/damping 30); wizard opens on settle; cancelled drag springs home
Kanban band collapse/expand
width animation via transform on a measured container, 280ms standard; column content fades in staggered 30ms
Snackbars
slide-up 16px + fade 200ms decelerate bottom-left; auto-dismiss at 4s with 150ms fade; hover pauses the timer
Review banner → overlay
banner chevron rotates 180° 150ms; overlay expands with sheet slide-up 260ms; returning collapses in reverse
Table interactions
row hover 50ms; stage-change: row background pulse once (brand-soft, 400ms decay); new/updated row: left accent bar wipes in 240ms; sort: rows reorder with FLIP 220ms, capped at 12 animated rows
Tasks popover footer swap
height auto-animate 180ms + field fade-in; Save enable state 150ms ease-in-out (Figma toggle timing)
Import wizard
step transitions as Move Stage; upload dropzone → success panel cross-fade 220ms; progress toast slides in from bottom-right 200ms; step-4 check draws in 320ms decelerate
Filter application
table rows exit/enter with 120ms fade + 20ms stagger (capped); filter badge pops in with spring scale 0→1
Segmented view toggle (table ⇄ kanban)
selected-segment background slides between segments 150ms ease-in-out; view cross-fade 200ms — no layout slide, views are structurally different
Maison AI FAB & sheet
FAB idle: none (restraint); press: scale 0.94 50ms; sheet: spring pop from FAB origin, suggestions stagger in 40ms apart
Skeletons / loading
data mutations are local-first so loading rarely shows; where it does (import parse), shimmer 1.2s linear loop
restraint: No entrance animation on the initial page render — the app should feel already-running, not arriving.
No parallax, no scroll-triggered effects, no count-up animations on table numbers (data credibility beats spectacle).
Empty states appear with a single 150ms fade — no illustration bounces.
